import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Connect to SQLite database
conn = sqlite3.connect('database.db')

# Read the table with content_description column
query = "SELECT * FROM your_table_name"
df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

# Close the connection
conn.close()

# Check column types
print("Column types:")
print(df.dtypes)

# Separate numeric and categorical columns
numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
categorical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns.tolist()

print(f"\nNumeric columns: {numeric_cols}")
print(f"Categorical columns: {categorical_cols}")

# Survey content_description column specifically
if 'content_description' in df.columns:
    print("\n=== Survey of content_description column ===")
    print(f"Data type: {df['content_description'].dtype}")
    print(f"Number of unique values: {df['content_description'].nunique()}")
    print(f"Number of null values: {df['content_description'].isnull().sum()}")
    
    # Show sample values
    print("\nSample values:")
    print(df['content_description'].head(10))
    
    # If categorical, show value counts
    if df['content_description'].dtype == 'object':
        print("\nTop 10 most frequent values:")
        print(df['content_description'].value_counts().head(10))
else:
    print("Error: 'content_description' column not found in the table")
